appendDesc.Shuffle and Block Storage: Also covers BlockManagerMaster and its endpoint on the driver, the block manager messages, replication policies, decommissioning and the fallback storage.

tour.title: BlockManagerMaster: the driver's view of all blocks
tour.description: Each BlockManager registers with the BlockManagerMaster on the driver (through BlockManagerMasterEndpoint) and reports the blocks it holds, so the driver knows where every block lives. The messages are defined in BlockManagerMessages, the master can ask executors to remove blocks through BlockManagerStorageEndpoint, replication policies choose peers for replicated blocks, and the decommissioner migrates blocks away from an executor that is shutting down.
